name: app-oviah-competitor-analysis-flow-comparison-cards
title: OVIAH competitor analysis: four period-app flows compared as arrow-linked step chains with logos
whatItIs: A white slide titled 'We looked beyond the interface. What already exists?' with four competitor cards (My Period Calendar, Flo, Clue, Ovia), each showing its core flow as arrow-linked steps (Track → Record → Predict) with bullet pros/cons and the app's logo, closing with 'The more features we add, the easier it is to overwhelm the user.'
whatItMeans: Analytical and honest; reducing each competitor to one flow line makes differences instantly comparable.
techniques: Reduce each competitor to a single arrow-linked flow.
Pair pros and cons as short bullets under each flow.
End competitive analysis with a stated design principle.

vocabulary.definition: A sequence of steps linked by arrows.
A guiding statement derived from research.
